units.source_text: 这"永远"从天而降，紧贴在我们的脸上、手上、腹部上，把我们完全掩埋。

en.t: This "eternity" fell from the sky, clinging tightly to our faces, hands, and bellies, and buried us completely.
It was something that made one feel cursed...

units.source_text: 是啊，停战这一天，我从层峦叠嶂那里响起的蝉声中也听见过这种诅咒似的"永远"。

en.t: Yes, on this day of the ceasefire, I had also heard that curse-like "eternity" in the cicadas' cries ringing out from the layered mountains.

units.source_text: 它用泥把我完全封闭在金色的墙上。

en.t: It sealed me completely with mud against the golden wall.
